# 365 Residential Services

> Year-round handyman and home improvement services in Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas. Repairs, renovations, custom carpentry, kitchen and bath upgrades, flooring, tile, fence work, and property maintenance for homeowners, landlords, and property managers. Quality craftsmanship you can trust, 365 days a year.

365 Residential Services is a locally owned home repair and improvement business serving the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex since its founding by David, starting with one toolbelt and one truck.

## Key facts

- Phone: (469) 616-0326
- Email: support@openwebcommunications.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–5pm; Saturday by appointment; Sunday closed
- Service area: Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex, Texas
- Response time: within 24 hours
- Warranty: 1-year workmanship warranty on all completed projects
- Estimates: free, no obligation, delivered within 24 hours
- Consultations: available by video (Virtual Inspection) or in person

## Services

- Tile & Backsplash: repairs, installations, regrouting, backsplash updates
- Flooring: hardwood, laminate, vinyl, tile; trim and baseboard finishing
- Wood & Fence Work: fence repair/replacement, gate reinforcement, custom wood projects
- Kitchen & Bath Upgrades: fixture swaps, cabinet hardware, vanity installs, faucet replacements
- General Home Repairs: drywall patching, door fixes, hardware installs, light carpentry
- Outdoor & Safety: deck repairs, wheelchair ramps, grab bars, handrails
- Custom Carpentry: built-in shelving, crown molding, custom trim work
- Property Maintenance: recurring maintenance packages for landlords and property managers

## Service areas

Dallas, Irving, Allen, Addison, Plano, Frisco, Arlington, Wylie — and the entire DFW metroplex.
